Changes.note: Switching a policy on or off holds at once in every köşk, medrese and course, without asking; your name goes to the audit log with the old and the new value. While Enrolment always needs approval is on, a talebe's own enrolment becomes an application that waits for the course team; registrations from a partner application are still enrolled directly. While Course recordings cannot be public is on, no recording is shown to people outside the course, and a köşk cannot switch the rule off in its own settings. A policy is undone by switching it back; applications that waited meanwhile do not turn into seats by themselves.

PlatformSettingsPage.instantNote: Every change takes effect at once and is written to the audit log.
PlatformSettingsPage.intro: Platform policies apply in every köşk, medrese and course. A policy closes a permission; a köşk, medrese or course cannot open it again.
PlatformSettingsPage.policies.approval.b: While on, no course can be joined directly; every enrolment becomes a request and the course team approves it. In unlisted köşks enrolment is always approved, whatever this setting says.
PlatformSettingsPage.policies.recordings: While on, no recording can be made public or uploaded to YouTube; only enrolled students and the course team watch recordings.
PlatformSettingsPage.saveFailed: The policy could not be saved
